quotes.author: R M
quotes.text: Our family (3 kids, 3 adults) had an excellent outing today with Captain Ryan! He was very knowledgeable, skilled, and chose fishing locations based on our interests! We caught a bunch of fish and some were huge! He’s got a great sense of humor, shared many tips and tricks for reeling, and engaged the kids too! He even let the kids pull in the crab traps and showed them how to catch a school of fish using a net! Would highly recommend Captain Ryan and will definitely book again the next time we are in Myrtle!

So we fished with Captain Ryan on June 5, 2024 .. a group of 4 adults and a 8 year old all had a great time. We caught sharks, red fish and flounder...we also checked crab traps that he had set and had some in every trap. Captain Ryan made sure we all enjoyed the trip and even made a quick stop on an island when some started feeling sick to get their bearings. We plan on going out with Captain Ryan on future vacations and would definitely recommend.

quotes.author: SWAMPDONKEY CATFISHING
quotes.text: We went out with Capt Ryan... Great experience. From the moment Capt Ryan picked us up until the time he dropped us off he was great to be around and worked really hard to provide us the best bait and get us in the best locations to have a great day. We caught several nice black drum then got on a Red Drum Blitz that was epic!! Thanks Ryan for having us and providing exceptional service. We will be back next year!!

quotes.author: Robert Collichio
quotes.text: We have been out fishing with Captain Ryan for many years. He knows the intercostal and ocean waters extremely well and always takes us to the right places. I consider him a great person, explaining to us his reasoning, helping us with the tackle, and even cleans your catch when you return. I highly recommend him!

quotes.author: Tim Abeln
quotes.text: This was our 3rd year using Captain Ryan. He has always taken care of us. He always ask if we’re looking to catch something specific and then do everything he can to try and get you on it. This year my son wanted to get a shark and we did. If we’re in Myrtle Beach again I would definitely use him again

quotes.author: Joey Brinkley
quotes.text: Captain Ryan always does a great job. He has became our go to guy and we recommend him to others as well. Caught some good sized red fish even with the water being rough and dirty. Ready for the next one.
